title: SCORE-SHAPE EVIDENCE GATE
research_question: Can richer pre-outcome retrieval-score evidence distinguish RETRIEVE from ABSTAIN better than always-retrieve and the official top-score threshold strategy, without embeddings, LLMs, RepoMap, ground-truth files, or repository-answer leakage?

retrieval_backends.primary_reason: Frozen before method development and has the stronger positive-only and always-retrieve baseline among the two reproduced lexical/BM25 systems.
retrieval_backends.if_retrieve: use that ranker's existing frozen top-20 result unchanged

target.label_use: training/evaluation on allowed folds only; outer test fold receives no ground-truth label or gold-file information

features: top5 score mass / top20 score mass
normalized entropy of non-negative top20 score distribution

cross_validation.outer: repository-grouped 5-fold; prefer official assign_repo_folds already recorded in E005_natural_selective_cv.json repo_folds for the 427 manifest
cross_validation.inner_threshold: within each outer-training set, repository-grouped inner CV predictions; choose probability threshold maximizing Selective Success@20 on inner validation only; then fit on all outer-training data and evaluate once on outer-test
cross_validation.if_nested_cv_invalid: STOP E006; do not fall back to in-sample threshold tuning

ablation.C3_NO_CONCENTRATION: remove normalized entropy, top5/top20 mass, and top1 z-score
